name: @loombre/wg-native
description: Lane WG1 (STATE.md "Loombre Remote" R1/R9/R11, RG1/RG2): the embedded userspace WireGuard core — Go glue (native/) over golang.zx2c4.com/wireguard's device + tun/netstack, loaded into Node via koffi. No packet forwarding: the only netstack socket is the local RG2 listener.
